test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ROAR : QZNQ :: HEAR : QZDG :: DAMP : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (1) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• ROAR : QZNQ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5b30cbc4df82c5a955dccfefcfc41ee262fb8a57902b27ed111d2c389e15a32.png] 

And,

 
• HEAR : QZDG​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37f01852576fdaff720ea2d1072bae068c4229efbad187e93da2829217093a1f.png] 

Similarly,

 
• DAMP : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ffd7be6c769bc0ea913948c5859402ab4b92dfc95b87fba02f4b01f937e3f5e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**OLZC**".
